blocks.text: Glycosuria or proteinuria is cause for deferral of medical certificate issuance until additional studies determine the status of the endocrine and/or urinary systems. If the glycosuria has been determined not to be due to carbohydrate intolerance, the AME may issue the certificate. Trace or 1+ proteinuria in the absence of a history of renal disease is not cause for denial.

blocks.text: The AME may request additional urinary tests when they are indicated by history or examination. These should be reported on FAA Form 8500-8 or attached to the form as an addendum.
